an5.157:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcannaṃ bhikkhave, puggalānaṃ kathā dukkathā puggalaṃ puggalaṃ upanidhāya.
an5.157:2.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave, assaddhassa saddhākathā dukkathā?
an5.157:2.2: assaddho bhikkhave, saddhākathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati, kuppati, vyāpajjati, patitthīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayaṃ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:2.4: taṃ hi so bhikkhave saddhāsampadaṃ attani na sampassati. na ca labhati tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:3.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave, dussīlassa sīlakathā dukkathā?
an5.157:3.2: dussīlo bhikkhave, sīlakathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati, kuppati, vyāpajjati, patitthīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayaṃ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:3.4: taṃ hi so bhikkhave, sīlasampadaṃ attani na sampassati, na ca labhati tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:4.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave, appassutassa bāhusaccakathā dukkathā?
an5.157:4.2: appassuto bhikkhave, bāhusaccakathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayaṃ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:4.4: taṃ hi so bhikkhave, sutasampadaṃ attani na sampassati. na ca labhati tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:5.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave, macchariyassa cāgakathā dukkathā?
an5.157:5.2: maccharī bhikkhave cāgakathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati, vyāpajjati patitthīyati, kopaṃ ca dosaṃ ca appaccayaṃ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:5.4: taṃ hi so bhikkhave cāgasampadaṃ attani na sampassati. na ca labhati tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:6.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave, duppaññassa paññākathā dukkathā?
an5.157:6.2: duppañño bhikkhave paññākathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patitthīyati, kopaṃ ca dosaṃ ca appaccayaṃ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:6.4: taṃ hi so bhikkhave, paññāsampadaṃ attani na sampassati. na ca labhati tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:6.6: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ puggalānaṃ kathā dukkathā puggalaṃ puggalaṃ upanidhāya.
an5.157:7.1: pañcannaṃ bhikkhave puggalānaṃ kathā sukathā puggalaṃ puggalaṃ upanidhāya.
an5.157:8.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave, saddhassa saddhākathā sukathā?
an5.157:8.2: saddho bhikkhave, saddhākathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na vyāpajjati na patitthīyati, na kopaṃ ca dosaṃ ca appaccayaṃ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:8.4: taṃ hi so bhikkhave, saddhāsampadaṃ attani sampassati. labhati ca tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:9.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave, sīlavato sīlakathā sukathā?
an5.157:9.2: sīlavā bhikkhave, sīlakathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na vyāpajjati na patitthīyati, na kopaṃ ca dosaṃ ca appaccayaṃ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:9.4: taṃ hi so bhikkhave, sīlasampadaṃ attani sampassati. labhati ca tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:10.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave, bahussutassa bāhusaccakathā sukathā?
an5.157:10.2: bahussuto bhikkhave, bāhusaccakathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na vyāpajjati na patitthīyati, na kopaṃ ca dosaṃ ca appaccayaṃ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:10.4: taṃ hi so bhikkhave, sutasampadaṃ attani sampassati. labhati ca tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:11.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave, cāgavato cāgakathā sukathā?
an5.157:11.2: cāgavā bhikkhave, cāgakathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na vyāpajjati na patitthīyati, na kopaṃ ca dosaṃ ca appaccayaṃ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:11.4: taṃ hi so bhikkhave, cāgasampadaṃ attani sampassati. labhati ca tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:12.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave, paññavato paññākathā sukathā?
an5.157:12.2: paññavā bhikkhave, paññākathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na vyāpajjati na patitthīyati, na kopaṃ ca dosaṃ ca appaccayaṃ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:12.4: tañhi so bhikkhave, paññāsampadaṃ attani sampassati. labhati ca tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:12.6: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ puggalānaṃ kathā sukathā puggalaṃ puggalaṃ upanidhāyāti.
